negative_findings.description: Every core source in this cell (LinkedIn company pages, people tabs, content search, personal profiles; X timelines; Facebook pages) sits behind an authentication wall and platform ToS that prohibit automated scraping.
negative_findings.result_summary: No unauthenticated, ToS-clean bulk feed exists for the highest-value sources in this cell. Search-engine indexing of public LinkedIn posts is the only login-free partial window found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design for A5 cannot assume crawlability; it must budget for analyst time, in-product saved searches/alerts, or a licensed data product (LinkedIn Talent Insights / Sales Navigator).

negative_findings.description: No LinkedIn company-page slug for OTP Mobil / SimplePay, Gránit Bank, CIB Bank, UniCredit Bank Hungary or Revolut Hungary was confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only OTP Bank, MBH Bank, K&H Csoport, Erste Magyarország, Raiffeisen Bank Hungary, Barion and FinTechZone slugs were observed in search results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The payments side of the actor map is under-covered relative to the banking side; several major payments and challenger actors have no confirmed handle yet.

negative_findings.description: X/Twitter is a thin channel for Hungarian banking personnel news; the corporate accounts found are low-volume and Facebook is used mainly for consumer marketing rather than appointments.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only one Hungarian bank corporate X handle (@otpbank_hu) was confirmed; MNB's Facebook page was the only social account observed actually carrying a leadership-transition post.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Effort in this cell should be weighted heavily toward LinkedIn; X/Facebook are confirmation channels, not discovery channels.

negative_findings.description: The Hungarian idiom query around 'csatlakoztam' returned ecosystem articles rather than individual announcement posts.
negative_findings.result_summary: Open-web search on 'csatlakoztam' + fintech surfaced portals (fintech.hu, FinTechZone, hunfintech.com) but no direct self-announcement posts, unlike 'örömmel osztom meg' which did.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Idiom selection materially changes yield; the phrase list must be tuned empirically rather than assumed, and 'örömmel osztom meg' should be the anchor phrase.

negative_findings.result_summary: Candidates are recorded with confidence scores only; the OTP Mobil slug in particular is an explicit hypothesis.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream liveness verification must run before any of these are promoted to a monitored watchlist.

coverage_gaps.description: Payments-sector actors (OTP Mobil/SimplePay, GIRO Zrt., Revolut Hungary, Wise Budapest, PayPal/Global Payments/Worldline local entities, ATM and terminal vendors) lack confirmed social handles.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass resolving LinkedIn company slugs for each payments actor via authenticated LinkedIn company search, then snapshot each People tab.

coverage_gaps.description: No headcount-growth baseline has been captured for any Hungarian bank or PSP; the 'employee growth curve' signal named in the cell rationale requires a first snapshot to become a time series.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Establish a monthly snapshot routine (total employees, top functions, top locations, 6/12-month growth) for the ~12 priority company pages; evaluate LinkedIn Talent Insights or a licensed firmographic provider for a compliant automated feed.

coverage_gaps.description: The Hungarian announcement-phrase lexicon is validated for only one idiom; variants ('büszkén jelentem be', 'új fejezet kezdődik', 'kinevezésemről', 'gratulálunk') are untested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Empirically test a 10-15 phrase Hungarian lexicon against LinkedIn content search and site:-scoped web search, and keep only phrases with demonstrated yield.

coverage_gaps.description: No compliant technical collection path has been identified for the auth-walled core of this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide explicitly between (a) analyst-in-the-loop manual review with saved alerts, (b) licensed LinkedIn products, or (c) search-engine-index proxying — and document the legal basis, including GDPR handling of named individuals' role data.

coverage_gaps.description: Adjacent self-publication channels not examined: employer-branding subpages (LinkedIn Life tabs), Instagram/TikTok recruitment content, Hungarian professional communities (e.g. Facebook groups for banking professionals), and personal blogs/Substacks of Hungarian fintech figures.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a follow-up sweep for Hungarian-language banking/fintech professional groups and creator newsletters as secondary weak-signal channels.

brief: Hungary's professional-network layer is overwhelmingly LinkedIn-centric: the major banks (OTP, MBH, K&H, Erste, Raiffeisen) and the leading PSP Barion all maintain active company pages, and Hungarian executives reliably self-announce moves using a small set of local idioms, with 'örömmel osztom meg' empirically the highest-yield anchor phrase — a search on it surfaced real appointment posts across OTP, MBH, MNB and Gránit. X and Facebook are thin by comparison and function as confirmation rather than discovery channels, though MNB's Facebook page does carry genuine leadership-transition posts. The binding constraint in this cell is access, not availability: nearly every high-value source is auth-walled and ToS-restricted, so the only login-free window found is search-engine indexing of public linkedin.com/posts and /in/ URLs. Priority next steps are resolving the missing payments-sector company slugs and taking a first headcount-curve baseline so the employee-growth signal becomes a time series.
